repos_data.description: An open-source, macOS text action popup for running custom scripts, AI actions, and extensible workflows on selected text.
Strata Files: a fast, native, keyboard-first file manager and Finder alternative for macOS. Instant search, live folder sizes, disk usage map, dual pane.

The free, open-source, on-device Grammarly alternative for Mac and Windows. Spelling, grammar, tone checks and rewrites in Slack, Teams, Outlook, Mail & Zoom — powered by Apple Intelligence and Windows Phi Silica; your text never leaves your device.
